title: The Whispering Corner

objectives.text: The clerk under Grand Central's clock
Ask the redcaps by Grand Central's gates
objectives.note: A redcap remembers a lady with a cane who took the 41st St side exit.

objectives.text: Face the tile. Say it for her.

rewards.text: Feeney's thanks; he slips you tomorrow's track changes (a fast-travel tip)
rewards.payNote: Kindness: no pay. Feeney's track-change tips instead.

where: Grand Central, information booth and the whispering arches; E 41st St
mobile: No timers; the Thursday window repeats weekly and the map marks it.
